propositions: Agentic runs waste 40-70% of request budget repeating identical tool calls without memoization; a search_files call repeated 144x and a loop on '(no matches)' result 62x represent the core waste case

The existing runaway guard aborts pathological runs at the backstop but does not prevent duplicate re-executions or re-payment of round-trips before trip point; memoization plus graduated nudge-then-abort prevents waste

Read-only deterministic tools (read_file, search_files, list_directory, show_ticket) with stable sentinel-empty results like '(no matches)' must be memoized and nudged on repeat; tools returning 'Error:'-prefixed strings must not be memoized and must re-execute on retry

Memoization wrapper must be stacked at the shared agent-call seam between the runaway guard (outer) and steering (inner) so the guard observes all tool-call signatures including memoized duplicates for accurate distinct-ratio window math

Nudge escalation uses static templated text (level-1 on first repeat, level-2 thereafter) to remain byte-stable for provider prompt caching and steer the model away from loops without manifest coupling
Live Bedrock capture must demonstrate either a nudge-broken loop or nudge-to-actuator escalation with usage-log figures and be recorded as a durable in-repo artifact under docs/experiments/
